# Smart Chests V__VERSION__

**One terminal. Every chest.** Search all the storage around you from a single screen, then withdraw or deposit without opening a single chest.

## What's new in v__VERSION__

__CHANGES__

## Download

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| **`SmartChests-__VERSION__-mc26.3-fabric.jar`** | The mod. Put it in your `mods` folder. |

**Requirements:** Minecraft `26.3`, [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) `0.19+`, [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api), Java 25.

## Install in 30 seconds

1. Install Fabric for Minecraft 26.3.
2. Drop **Fabric API** and **SmartChests-__VERSION__-mc26.3-fabric.jar** into `.minecraft/mods`.
3. Launch the game. Config is created at `config/smartchests.json`.

Recipes, config options and tips are in the [README](https://github.com/__REPO__#readme).
